introHtml: Mixie magnifying glasses combine the utility of a precision magnifier with the durability needed for everyday carry. Ideal for safety managers distributing inspection tools or HR directors offering practical employee gifts, these custom magnifying glasses feature a sturdy frame and scratch-resistant lens. Choose from several magnification strengths and add your logo via screen printing or laser engraving for a crisp, lasting impression.
